(1) 单变量观察分母:  $\left\{\begin{aligned}x+\frac{k}{x-a}&=(x-a)+\frac{k}{(x-a)}+a\\ x+\frac{k}{mx-a}&=\frac{(mx-a)}{m}+\frac{k}{(mx-a)}+\frac{a}{m}\end{aligned}\right.$

(2) 双变量观察分母:  $\left\{\begin{aligned}2a+3b+\frac{1}{a+b}+\frac{1}{a+2b}&=a+b+\frac{1}{a+b}+a+2b+\frac{1}{a+2b}\\ \frac{a}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}&=\frac{a+b-b}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}=\frac{a+b}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}-1\\ \frac{3b+2a}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}&=\frac{b+2b+2a}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}=1+\frac{2(a+b)}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}\\ a+\frac{1}{a-b}+\frac{1}{a+b}&=a-b+\frac{1}{a-b}+a+b+\frac{1}{a+b}\end{aligned}\right.$
